findings.title: Low Contrast Text on Title Screen
findings.problem: The white tagline text under the title 'SMDUEL' lacks contrast against the bright sunset background, making it hard to read.
findings.why: Players may struggle to quickly understand the context and premise of the game, reducing the impact and professional feel of the title screen.
findings.fix: Add a subtle dark drop shadow or semi-opaque background panel behind the tagline text to increase contrast and legibility.

findings.title: Unclear Radar Instrument
findings.where: Arena and Road screens, bottom-left corner
findings.problem: The radar is a dark circle with only faint lines and a small white triangle, with no visible sweep or detected contacts.
findings.why: This makes the radar look static or broken rather than a useful gameplay tool, potentially confusing players about its purpose and value.
findings.fix: Add a distinct rotating sweep line and bright contacts when enemies or objects are nearby to clearly communicate functionality.

findings.title: Poor Visual Feedback for Vehicle Condition
findings.where: Arena and Road screens, top-right corner panels
findings.problem: The armor and underbody condition indicators use small boxes and minimal text with low color differentiation.
findings.why: Players cannot quickly assess vehicle damage from a glance, which diminishes situational awareness and urgency in combat or travel.
findings.fix: Use larger, colored bars or segmented gauges with clear red/green color states and stronger outlines for armor and health sections.

findings.title: Crowded UI Text in City Screen
findings.problem: The informational text ('New York · Day 0, daytime · $2000' and controls) is clustered tightly in the top center with small font and minimal spacing.
findings.why: This clutter reduces readability and visual breathing space, diminishing the player's ability to effortlessly absorb key session info.
findings.fix: Separate and space out status info and control hints into distinct UI zones, possibly moving the control instructions to a dedicated lower corner.

findings.title: Cluttered and Dense Vehicle Constructor List
findings.problem: The list of car parts and weapons is very densely packed with small font and no clear hierarchy or grouping.
findings.why: Players may struggle to navigate and edit their vehicle setup quickly, frustrating the user experience and complicating decision making.
findings.fix: Introduce collapsible sections or spacing between groups, increase font size slightly, and add subtle background shading or borders to separate logical items.
